cases.name: codex-agent
cases.description: Pins version reconciliation, Codex TOML conversion, and source-versus-installed checksums for a generated agent.

input.markdown:
---
name: fixture-agent
description: Reviews code
model: gpt-5
---
Review carefully.
Report "why".

expected.reconciled_markdown:
---
name: fixture-agent
description: Reviews code
model: gpt-5
metadata:
  version: "2.4.6"
---
Review carefully.
Report "why".
expected.codex_toml:
name = "fixture-agent"
description = "Reviews code"
model = "gpt-5"
developer_instructions = "Review carefully.\nReport \"why\"."
